verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an Indian data-residency option and self-hosted Docker/Kubernetes deployments for secure, private enterprise use. That covers the data-residency part of the story, but the pack has no evidence of HIPAA/BAA or SOC 2. Missing for 10: HIPAA compliance and BAA availability, SOC 2 attestation, residency regions beyond India, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options

citations.quote: Indian data residency is available for deployments where data must remain in India.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
